# Fulfilment Status Chip

## Summary
The one place the fulfilment blocks decide how a lifecycle hue renders: fill, border and text are all mixed `in oklch` from a single hue toward the theme's own tokens, so the chip stays legible on light and dark grounds and the three can never come apart.

## API
- `StatusChip` — template-only component; args `@style: StatusStyle` (`{ value, label, hue }`), optional `@compact`
- `StatusStyle` — the option-table row shape that `Order Status` and `Shipment Status` export for each value

## Usage
```ts
import { StatusChip } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/fulfilment/fulfilment-status-chip';
import { orderStatusStyle } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/fulfilment/order-status';

<StatusChip @style={{orderStatusStyle @model.status}} />
```

## Non-goals
Not a status field: it renders a hue it is handed. Vocabularies and transitions live in the status fields that consume it. For a transition-graph status use the catalog `Status` field and `StatePill` instead.
